parsed_json.up: Select: activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Source: activities, molecule_dictionary, target_dictionary. Join: activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, activities.tid = target_dictionary.tid. Filter: target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_units = 'nM', standard_type IN ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50'), standard_value < 50. Sort: activity_id ASC. Limit: 200.
